title: Digital panopticon: ‘When you work faster, you have to work even faster’ Amazon workers tell MEPs on AI work surveillance
lede: Seven MEPs from the employment committee visited Amazon warehouses in Germany and Poland this week - ahead of the EU Commission’s Quality Jobs Act proposal expected in December.

title: [Interview] ‘I don’t care’ about the associate membership label row: Lead MEP Javier Moreno Sánchez on upcoming EU-Canada summit
lede: “Everybody's focusing on the legal basis of Ursula von der Leyen’s associate membership announcement, but frankly I don't care,” says the European Parliament lead on Canada. He hopes digital trade, critical raw materials and Erasmus+ will be prioritised in talks this week in Montreal.

title: Caretaker PM Netanyahu expected to escalate violence, as EU sanctions talk on hold until new Israeli government formed
lede: Israel's "vibrant democracy" gave the most votes to a man wanted for war crimes by the International Criminal Court in The Hague and accused of perpetrating genocide by UN experts, posing questions on whether Israeli society is aligned with EU values.
